about.text: A semi-hard cheese made from high-quality sheep's milk or its mixture with cow's or goat's milk. It has a mild nutty flavor, soft texture, and a natural rind. Less salty than brined cheeses, with a fat content of 50% or higher.

sources.text: Sheep (or sheep with cow/goat) milk, fat at least 50 percent, mild nutty, relatively soft; no ripening time found, estimated
